attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, conferences and seminars approved by persons designated by the Board under its guidelines; lecturers/discussion leaders get 2 hours per presentation hour (same course once per period); repeated courses generally not credited.

topics.who: All licensees: suicide assessment, treatment and management

rules.notes: Biennial renewal; 40 contact hours per renewal period. Ethics hour minimums are not stated in Regulation 110-1.
